headline: Approved previous meeting's minutes unanimously; chief reviewed police response counts, top incident types, and staffing.
summary: The annual report was moved to next month's meeting due to attendance and time. Commendations were listed for four people, plus department commendations from Mayor Emma Mulvaney-Stanak and Chief Deputy State's Attorney Sally Adams.
decisions: Approved the previous meeting's minutes unanimously.

plain_text:
Police Commission  
Tuesday, September 29th, 2026 
Remote via Zoom and In-person in Contois Auditorium, City Hall 
Burlington, Vermont 
DRAFT MINUTES 
 
Members Present: Chair Finneran, Commissioner Ginorio, Commissioner V on Hermann 
Members Online: Commissioner Paul 
Staff Present: Interim Chief Burke in-person 
 
1. Agenda  
1.1. Call to Order 
Meeting called to order at 6:00pm by Chair Finneran 
 
1.2. Roll Call and Determination of Quorum 
Required quorum present.  
 
1.3. Motions for Additions or Modifications to Agenda (Time Limited: 15 Minutes) 
Chair Finneran moves to remove the annual report and add it to next month’s meeting due to 
attendance and time. Commissioner Ginorio seconds, passes. Agenda adopted.  
 
2. Adopt Minutes 
2.1. Motion to adopt previous meeting’s minutes 
Commissioner Paul and Commissioner Ginorio move, passes unanimously.  
 
3. Public Forum (Time Limited: 10 Minutes) 
3.1. The Public is Invited to Address the Commission 
No one present to comment.  
 
 
4. Police Department Business 
4.1. Chief’s Report 
Chief Burke reviews data, graphs, and answers questions regarding the presented information 
regarding officer response counts, top incident types, and staffing.  
 
5. Commission Business 
5.1. Reports from all committees 
Complaints Committee 
Animal Control Committee 
Complaints Committee to meet following the conclusion of the regular monthly meeting.  
 
6. Commendations 
6.1. BPD Commendations 
Commendations for Officer Philbrick, Officer Gonzalez, CSO Young, CAIP Manager Wageling, 
as well as Department commendations from the Mayor Emma Mulvaney-Stanak and Chief 
Deputy State’s Attorney Sally Adams.
7. Announcement of Next Meeting Date – 10/27/2026 
 
8. Adjournment  
8.1. Motion to Adjourn 
Commissioner moves, Chair Finneran seconds. Passes unanimously. Adjourned at 6:34pm
